_note: Enemies for the retro side-view battles on the map itself (scripts/stage_battle.gd). art: sprite prefix in assets/explore (<art>_idle, _idle_b, _tell, _wail, _claw, _hurt, _calm, _fade). special: the signature move, telegraphed one enemy turn ahead by its tell; a Hatid prayer landed during the tell cancels it. tip_flag: if the player heard this in the map, the tell says how to beat it. send_home: pray this prayer while the enemy is below this share of its HP to send it home instead of scattering it.

magbabalot.name: MANG ANDOY
magbabalot.opening: Mang Andoy drifts out from under the balete, his empty basket swinging. He wants you to answer.

claw.name: COLD HAND
claw.text: Grey fingers reach for Teo's throat.

special.name: TAWAG
special.tell: Mang Andoy draws a breath that does not end. His eyes go red. He is about to call Teo's name.
special.text: "TEODORO!" He calls in Lola's voice. Don't answer!

magbabalot.tip: Mang Isko said it: you never answer, you pray. A HATID prayer now will drown out the call.
